text:
I read all 10 files in the repo. Your `geo.config.json` says AI search crawlers are allowed and training crawlers are blocked, so I judged the robots rules against that. ## High severity 1. **`/pricing` is set to noindex, but it's in the sitemap and has a canonical.** - `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` has `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`, while `public/sitemap.xml:4` lists the page. - The page will drop out of Google and AI search. It's usually a top commercial page. - The signals also conflict with each other, because the sitemap and canonical both say "index me". - Fix: remove the `robots` field. If the noindex is intentional, remove the sitemap entry and the canonical instead. 2. **`/blog` is rendered only in the browser.** - `app/blog/page.tsx:1` has `'use client'`, and lines 7–9 fetch `/api/posts` inside `useEffect`. - Crawlers, and most AI crawlers in particular, don't run JS. They see only `

Blog

`. - There is no `/api/posts` route in the repo, so even in a browser the list will fail. - Fix: make it a server component and fetch the posts on the server (`async function Page()`). Give each post its own URL, such as `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`, and add those URLs to the sitemap. The page also has no `metadata` export at all (line 1 onward). 3. **`robots.txt` only half-enforces your policy.** - `public/robots.txt:4-5` blocks only GPTBot. - Other training crawlers fall under `User-agent: *` and are allowed: `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Meta-ExternalAgent` and `Bytespider`. - Fix: add a `Disallow: /` group for each of those. Leave `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Claude-SearchBot` and `Claude-User` allowed. The `*` rule already allows them, but you could list them explicitly to match the policy. ## Medium severity 4. **There is no `Sitemap:` line in `public/robots.txt`.** Add `Sitemap: https://www.ledger.example/sitemap.xml`. 5. **`` has no `lang`.** `app/layout.tsx:11` should be ``, which matches `geo.config.json`. 6. **There is no structured data anywhere.** - Nothing in the repo emits JSON-LD, which helps both search engines and AI answer engines. - Add `Organization` and `WebSite` JSON-LD in `app/layout.tsx`, and `SoftwareApplication` with `Offer` on the home and pricing pages. - Add `Article` on blog posts and `BreadcrumbList` on docs. 7. **Canonicals are inconsistent.** - Only `app/page.tsx:1` and `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` set one. - `app/docs/page.tsx:1` and `app/blog/page.tsx` have none. - Fix: set `alternates: { canonical: './' }` in the layout metadata (`app/layout.tsx:3-7`) so every page inherits a self-referencing canonical, or set one per page. 8. **Titles and descriptions are weak.** - `app/docs/page.tsx:1` has the title "Docs". - `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` has the title "Pricing" and the description "Plans for every team size." - Neither names the brand or says anything specific. - Use something like "Ledger Pricing: free for up to 3 people" and "Ledger Docs: set up bank feeds and invoicing". - Use `title: { template: '%s | Ledger', default: ... }` in `app/layout.tsx:4`. ## Low severity 9. **Content is very thin.** - Each page has a single sentence: `app/page.tsx:4`, `app/docs/page.tsx:4` and `app/pricing/page.tsx:4`. - AI engines need quotable, specific content. Add feature descriptions, a pricing table with real numbers, an FAQ, and docs with actual steps. - On the pricing page, "Free for up to three people" is a good fact. Expand it with paid tiers. 10. **There is no Open Graph or Twitter metadata.** Add `openGraph`, `twitter` and an image in `app/layout.tsx:3-7`. 11. **The sitemap has no ``.** `public/sitemap.xml:3-6` would benefit from it. Better still, generate it with `app/sitemap.ts` so blog posts are included automatically. 12. **The nav uses plain `` tags.** `app/layout.tsx:13` should use `next/link` for client-side navigation and prefetching. 13. **`/llms.txt` is optional.** Adding `public/llms.txt` with a short site summary and key links is cheap, but support from AI search engines is inconsistent. ## What's fine - `app/thank-you/page.tsx` is noindex and correctly left out of the sitemap. - `metadataBase` is set. - The canonical hosts match the sitemap. - The `data-nosnippet` on the cookie banner (`app/layout.tsx:15`) is appropriate. I haven't changed anything. I can apply the fixes if you'd like. For item 1, I need to know whether the pricing noindex is intentional.
